name: What are the common signs of rot damage around windows in older homes in Pacifica?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of rot damage around windows in older homes in Pacifica?

acceptedAnswer.text: In older homes in Pacifica, common signs of rot around windows can include peeling or bubbling paint on sills and frames, soft or spongy wood when pressed, visible mold or mildew growth, or a distinct earthy, musty smell. The coastal climate with its fog and humidity can accelerate rot if seals or paint are compromised, making regular inspection crucial for early detection.
acceptedAnswer.description: In older Pacifica homes, look for peeling paint, soft wood, visible mold, or a musty smell around windows. The coastal climate accelerates rot, so regular inspection is key.
